title: Data-Quality-Aware Fundus Classification with Anatomy-Guided Glaucoma Assessment and Cross-Dataset Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29834v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background: Deep learning fundus classifiers often perform well internally, but duplicated images, inconsistent labels, acquisition differences and poor threshold transfer can undermine their reliability. We assess nine-class classifiers beyond internal accuracy, using a data audit, frozen-model external evaluation and an anatomy-guided specialist. Methods: Nine-class experts (ConvNeXt-Small, EfficientNetV2-Small, DenseNet169) were trained with three seeds. Auditing 5,318 images for exact duplicates and cross-label conflicts removed 464 conflict groups (942 images) and six same-label copies, leaving 4,370 images. An anatomy-guided glaucoma specialist read disc-centred crops with vessel and disc/cup segmentation maps, plus cup-to-disc features. Frozen models were evaluated on RFMiD and JSIEC, and a prespecified comparison on REFUGE was replicated on ORIGA, G1020 and PAPILA. Results: ConvNeXt-Small reached an internal accuracy of 0.910,

translated_title: 数据质量感知的眼底分类：基于解剖引导的青光眼评估与跨数据集评估
translated_abstract: 背景：深度学习眼底分类器通常在内部数据上表现良好，但重复图像、标签不一致、采集差异以及阈值迁移能力差等因素可能损害其可靠性。我们超越单纯的内部准确率，通过数据审计、冻结模型外部评估和解剖引导的专家模型来评估九分类分类器。方法：使用三个随机种子训练九分类专家模型（ConvNeXt-Small、EfficientNetV2-Small、DenseNet169）。对5,318张图像进行数据审计以查找完全重复和跨标签冲突，移除了464个冲突组（942张图像）和六个同标签重复副本，最终保留4,370张图像。解剖引导的青光眼专家模型读取以视盘为中心的裁剪图像，并结合血管以及视盘/视杯分割图和杯盘比特征。冻结模型在RFMiD和JSIEC数据集上进行外部评估，并且在REFUGE上预先设定的比较在ORIGA、G1020和PAPILA上进行了重复验证。结果：ConvNeXt-Small达到了0.910的内部准确率，
tldr: 该研究通过数据审计去除重复与标签冲突图像、构建融合分割特征的解剖引导青光眼专家模型，并在多个外部数据集上对冻结模型进行跨数据集评估，从而超越单一内部准确率来全面评估眼底九分类模型的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates nine-class fundus classifiers beyond internal accuracy by auditing data for duplicates and label conflicts, employing an anatomy-guided glaucoma specialist with segmentation features, and performing frozen-model cross-dataset external evaluation.
